values: 高举战斧砸向敌人，对目标及周围敌人造成伤害并回复自身。
Karma strikes an enemy with his battleaxe, dealing damage to the target and nearby enemies while restoring his own HP.

选择一名敌人为目标，喀尔马高举战斧砸向目标，对目标造成400% + 40% ATK的伤害以及2.5秒眩晕。1秒后，战斧砸下位置产生半径1格的爆炸，对敌人造成400% + 50% ATK的基础伤害并外加上次施放该技能后喀尔马受到治疗效果总和40%的额外伤害，额外伤害至多不超过自身500% ATK，爆炸每命中一个非召唤物敌人都会恢复自身10% HP的生命值，并且战斗中每死亡一名非召唤物敌人都会使该效果额外回复等量的生命值。

Karma strikes an enemy with his battleaxe, dealing 400% + 40% ATK damage and stunning the target for 2.5s. After 1s, an explosion erupts within 1 tile of the impact tile, dealing 400% + 50% ATK damage plus extra damage equal to 40% of the total healing Karma has received since this skill was last cast. The extra damage cannot exceed 500% ATK.
Karma recovers 10% HP HP for each non-summoned enemy hit by the explosion. For each non-summoned enemy defeated during the battle, this healing increases by that same amount.
爆炸造成的基础伤害提升至420% + 50% ATK，命中敌人为自身回复最大生命值的比例提升至11%。
Increases the explosion's base damage to 420% + 50% ATK and the HP restored per enemy hit to 11% of his max HP.
爆炸造成的基础伤害提升至440% + 50% ATK，命中敌人为自身回复最大生命值的比例提升至12%。
Increases the explosion's base damage to 440% + 50% ATK and the HP restored per enemy hit to 12% of his max HP.
爆炸造成的基础伤害提升至460% + 50% ATK，命中敌人为自身回复最大生命值的比例提升至13%。
Increases the explosion's base damage to 460% + 50% ATK and the HP restored per enemy hit to 13% of his max HP.
爆炸造成的基础伤害提升至500% + 50% ATK，命中敌人为自身回复最大生命值的比例提升至15%。
Increases the explosion's base damage to 500% + 50% ATK and the HP restored per enemy hit to 15% of his max HP.
在当前位置留下药池为自身提供回复，并挥动战斧劈砍周围敌人。
Karma leaves a toxic pool at his location that restores his HP while he swings his battleaxe at nearby enemies.
喀尔使用大量亡灵药剂沐浴全身，原地留下一滩持续6秒，半径1格的药剂池。药剂池每秒会对范围内的敌人造成100% + 10% ATK的伤害，并为喀尔马回复140% + 20% ATK的生命值。同时马尔挥动战斧，对周围的敌人造成300% + 30% ATK的伤害。

Kar drenches himself in special potions, leaving behind a pool with a 1-tile radius at his location that lasts for 6s. The pool deals 100% + 10% ATK damage every second to enemies within it and restores 140% + 20% ATK HP to Karma every second. At the same time, Mar swings his battleaxe to deal 300% + 30% ATK damage to nearby enemies.
每秒为自身回复的生命值提升至160% + 20% ATK。
Increases HP restored per second to 160% + 20% ATK.
每秒为自身回复的生命值提升至180% + 20% ATK。
Increases HP restored per second to 180% + 20% ATK.
每秒为自身回复的生命值提升至200% + 20% ATK。
Increases HP restored per second to 200% + 20% ATK.
获得持续的生命回复，并挥舞战斧连续劈砍面前的敌人。
Karma continuously restores HP, then unleashes a flurry of axe strikes at enemies in front of him.
喀尔喝下药剂，使自身每秒回复20%最大生命值，持续5秒。随后马尔快速挥动战斧，对半径1格扇形范围内德敌人造成3次劈砍，每次造成140% + 20% ATK的伤害，最后一击还会将目标击倒，使其倒地2秒。

Kar downs a potion, restoring 20% of his max HP every second for 5s. Mar then unleashes a rapid 3-hit axe flurry against enemies in a 1-tile frontal arc, dealing 140% + 20% ATK damage per hit. The final hit also knocks targets down for 2s.
每次劈砍造成的伤害提升至160% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage of each axe strike to 160% + 20% ATK.
每次劈砍造成的伤害提升至180% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage of each axe strike to 180% + 20% ATK.
每次劈砍造成的伤害提升至200% + 20% ATK。
Increases the damage of each axe strike to 200% + 20% ATK.
战斗中，喀尔马获得11点受愈。
战斗中，喀尔马获得15点受愈。
战斗中，喀尔马获得19点受愈。
受到治疗后会提升自身最大生命值，并为自身提供额外的护甲魔抗与韧性。
When receiving healing, Karma increases his max HP and gains extra Phys & Magic DEF and Resilience.
喀尔马的肉体每次受到治愈都会变得更加强大，每受到自身初始最大生命值35%的治疗量可以使当前最大生命值增加40%，最多因此提升200%，并使自身体型略微增大。满层后自身额外提高60%护甲与魔抗和50点韧性，并使“裂爆屠戮”，“狂斧毒宴”，“亢奋杀心”的伤害范围增加一格。

Karma grows stronger from the healing he receives. For every 35% of his initial max HP he receives in healing, his max HP increases by 40% (up to 200%) and he grows slightly larger in size. At max stacks, Karma also gains 60% Phys & Magic DEF and 50 Resilience, and the damage range of Unfettered Carnage, Toxic Mosh Pit, and Bottled Bloodlust is increased by 1 tile.
最大生命值的增加比例提升至45%，该效果的上限提升至225%，满层后自身额外提高70%护甲与魔抗。
Increases the max HP gained each time to 45% and the max HP increase limit to 225%. At max stacks, Karma gains an extra 70% Phys & Magic DEF.
来自该技能的最大生命值提升至上限后，喀尔马会永久处于稳定状态，并且技能“狂斧毒宴”、“亢奋杀心”中战斧的攻击命中敌人时会附带15% HP的魔法伤害。

Once the max HP increase from this skill reaches its limit, Karma permanently gains steadfast. In addition, his axe strikes from Toxic Mosh Pit and Bottled Bloodlust deal 15% HP extra magic damage on hit.
最大生命值的增加比例提升至50%，上限提升至250%，满层后获得80%护甲与魔抗。
Increases the max HP gained each time to 50% and the max HP increase limit to 250%. At max stacks, Karma gains 80% Phys & Magic DEF.
受到药水影响后降低受到的伤害。
Karma reduces the damage he takes while affected by his own potions.
喀尔马受到自身药水的影响期间，受到的伤害降低50%。该效果无法叠加。
While affected by his own potions, Karma takes 50% less damage. This effect cannot stack.
